definitions.explanation: The chest area of the body, including the ribcage and the organs it houses. A medical/technical term used in hospitals, examinations, and anatomy; everyday speech prefers {胸|むね}.

examples.japanese: {胸部|きょうぶ}のレントゲンを{撮|と}る。
{胸部|きょうぶ}に{痛|いた}みを{感|かん}じたら、すぐに{病院|びょういん}へ。
examples.english: If you feel chest pain, go to a hospital immediately.

examples.japanese: {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}では{毎年|まいとし}{胸部|きょうぶ}{画像|がぞう}{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けている。
examples.english: I undergo chest imaging examinations every year as part of my health checkup.

notes:
Compound of {胸|むね} (chest) + {部|ぶ} (part/section). A clinical-register noun used mostly in medical and anatomical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸部|きょうぶ}レントゲン / {胸部|きょうぶ}{X線|エックスせん}: chest X-ray
- {胸部|きょうぶ}{外科|げか}: thoracic surgery
- {胸部|きょうぶ}{圧迫|あっぱく}: chest compression (e.g. CPR)
- {胸部|きょうぶ}{痛|つう}: chest pain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胸|むね}: chest — the everyday word; also used emotionally ({胸|むね}が{痛|いた}い 'heart aches')
- {腹部|ふくぶ}: abdomen — parallel medical term for the abdominal region
- {胸郭|きょうかく}: thorax (skeletal) — specifically the ribcage structure
